description: This file contains abstract class definitions and base classes for the TestLink project, primarily providing infrastructure for serialization, database, and attachment handling of managed objects. It defines classes such as 'tl', 'tlObject', 'tlObjectWithDB', 'tlObjectWithAttachments', and 'tlDBObject', which serve as foundational components for objects that interact with the database, support serialization interfaces, and manage attachments within the TestLink testing platform.

classes.name: tl
classes.description: Namespace-like abstract class defining status and error codes for TestLink operations.

classes.name: tlObject
classes.description: Base abstract class for all managed TestLink objects, providing user feedback and serialization interface management.

classes.name: tlObjectWithDB
classes.description: Extends tlObject to include database connection management for objects with database interactions.

classes.name: tlObjectWithAttachments
classes.description: Extends tlObjectWithDB to support attachment handling, including retrieving and deleting attachments.

classes.name: tlDBObject
classes.description: Provides support for object caching, database ID management, and factory methods for objects interacting with the database.

methods.name: setAuditLogOn
methods.description: Enables audit logging for the object.

methods.name: setAuditLogOff
methods.description: Disables audit logging for the object.

methods.name: setAuditEventSource
methods.description: Sets the source of audit events (e.g., GUI).

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing object ID and serialization interfaces.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.

methods.name: _clean
methods.description: Resets internal data of the object, intended to be overridden.

methods.name: getSupportedSerializationFormatDescriptions
methods.description: Returns format descriptors for supported serialization.

methods.name: handleNotImplementedMethod
methods.description: Returns an error code indicating a method is not implemented.

methods.name: getDBTables
methods.description: Returns a mapping of table names with and without prefix; can filter by specific names.

methods.name: getDBViews
methods.description: Returns a mapping of view names with and without prefix; can filter by specific names.
